title: Draft Comprehensive README.md
description: Create a detailed README.md file at the root of the repository to serve as the primary documentation for the Next Shadcn Dashboard Starter project.
details:
- Create a new file named README.md in the project root.
- Include the following sections:
  1. Project Title and Description: Clearly state the project name and a concise summary of its purpose.
  2. Features: List the key features (e.g., authentication, theming, data tables, charts, tRPC API, Prisma ORM, etc.).
  3. Technology Stack: Enumerate the main technologies and libraries used (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, etc.).
  4. Getting Started: Step-by-step instructions for cloning the repo, installing dependencies, setting up environment variables, and running the development server.
  5. Project Structure Overview: Briefly describe the main folders and their purposes (e.g., app, components, etc.).
  6. Deployment: Instructions for deploying to Vercel, including any required environment variables.
  7. Contribution Guidelines: (Optional) Brief note on how to contribute or where to find more info.
- Use Markdown best practices: clear headings, bullet points, code blocks for commands, and badges if available.
- Ensure all instructions are up to date and reflect the current project structure and dependencies.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the README.md file is present at the root, is well-formatted, and contains all required sections. Follow the setup instructions on a clean environment to ensure they work as described. Review for clarity, accuracy, and completeness.
